label: early original-phase token after r/s, in a prefix of s/r/p/b/z/m/t/3/1 tokens
explanation: Sparse original-phase feature (99% of mass in phase 0, never at t=0/1; peaks at t=2 and decays with t). It fires on an input token (mostly l, r, e, k, b, also t/o/u) right after r or s (prev_tok r/s has 15x/11x lift; prev2 s also strong), when the sequence so far consists only of tokens from {s,r,p,b,z,m,t,3,1} (first_tok s/p/t/3 enriched). It is a conjunction of current token, preceding token and prefix composition. Activations are strongest early (t=2-4) with l after r/s at the top. Near-zero on the delimiter (1% of mass) and copy phase. The predicate gets dev F1 0.44 (P 0.46, R 0.42). Misses are cases where one earlier token falls outside the prefix set, or where the preceding token is p/b/m rather than r/s. Loosening any condition lowers precision a lot, so the feature looks like a fuzzy conjunction over recent history and is not fully captured.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=r (+4.96), prev_tok=s (+4.91), prev2_tok=s (+4.78), prev2_tok=r (+4.19), prev2_tok=b (+3.88), prev2_tok=z (+3.73). Lower it: orig2=c (-3.62), orig2=j (-3.49), phase=2 (-3.03), in_tok=p (-2.97).
